job.title: Instructional Designer
job.description:
Thrivent's Learning team is looking for an Instructional Designer to build training for our financial advisors and member service staff.

What you'll do:
- Design and develop e-learning courses, job aids and instructor-led training
- Apply adult learning principles and the ADDIE model
- Partner with subject matter experts to define learning objectives
- Build courses in Articulate Storyline and Rise and publish them to our LMS
- Measure training effectiveness and improve courses based on data
- Write storyboards and scripts for video

What you bring:
- 2+ years designing training or curriculum
- Experience with Articulate 360 or similar authoring tools
- Knowledge of adult learning theory
- Strong writing and project management skills
- Experience with an LMS

professionalSummary.summary: Elementary teacher with 7 years of experience planning lessons, using data to adjust instruction, and leading teacher training.

achievements: Planned and taught daily lessons in reading, math and science for classes of 28 students
Raised the share of students meeting the state reading standard from 54% to 71% in two years
Built a Google Classroom course with weekly videos and quizzes used by 4 grade-level teachers
Led 6 after-school workshops for 40 teachers on using Seesaw and Google Forms
Used assessment data to group students and adjust lessons every 3 weeks
Wrote the school's new-teacher onboarding guide
Co-taught 2nd grade and designed a 4-week unit on plant life cycles
